$comment: Classification of every function holding a tokenHash/codeHash/replacedByHash digest lookup (any call whose argument has the key under a filter position, whatever its receiver), a position this gate cannot read (opaque-where: a where on a token model, an argument / select / include / data on a token model or a model with a relation to one, or an unpinned computed key in any filter), or a digest-key spelling the walk did not place (a floating key: a string in a list, a member read, a property outside a lookup, write or projection; or a direct call of a function that builds such an object). Enforced by scripts/checks/check-bearer-passkey-gate.mjs (plan: docs/archive/review/api-key-passkey-requirement-plan.md, C7). calls = the number of sites in the function: lookup calls, opaque calls, floating digest keys and builder calls, each counted once (a floating key inside a counted call of the same function adds none). Keys are <repo path>#<function>. refresh-bound entries name lifetime as <repo path>#<exported const> and at least one inlineGate. models: a token model (tokenHash/codeHash column) that no analysed lookup reaches, keyed by model name with a reason; empty while every token model has one. sqlObjects: SQL files (migrations, initdb, scripts/*.sql) that define or copy what a query can reach without naming a digest column, keyed by repo path with a reason (plan bearer-passkey-gate-coverage, C4). pgPools: the files importing createPool / createClient from src/lib/db/pool-factory, keyed by repo path with a reason (C5). nonBearerHashFields: unique String fields ending in hash / digest that are not bearer digests, keyed Model.field with a reason; empty today.

src/lib/auth/tokens/api-key.ts#validateA.reason: API key validator; every use passes the C3 gate after revocation, expiry and membership (C1).

src/lib/auth/tokens/operator-token.ts#va.reason: Operator token validator; every use passes the C3 gate after membership (C2).

src/lib/auth/tokens/extension-token.ts#v.reason: Extension-row token validator (BROWSER_EXTENSION, IOS_APP, IOS_AUTOFILL); every use passes the C3 gate after DPoP, except the three pinned passkeyExemption call sites (C5).

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#validateMcpT.reason: MCP access token validator; not gated per use (SC1): the token lives MCP_TOKEN_EXPIRY_SEC (1 h) and every mint, by code exchange or refresh rotation, is gated inline.

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#resolveRefre.reason: Pre-rotation tenant lookup for the IP gate on the MCP refresh grant; authenticates nothing itself — the rotation it precedes is gated inline in exchangeRefreshToken.

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#exchangeRefr.reason: MCP refresh rotation; passkeyEnforcementBlocks runs inline at the mint point, after replay detection, so a blocked user's 1 h access token cannot be renewed.

src/app/api/mobile/token/refresh/route.t.reason: iOS host refresh-token lookup; the rotation is gated inline in refreshIosToken (SC3), the refresh row lives at most the tenant idle limit, and the access row it mints is gated per use by validateExtensionToken. The second site is the row literal handed to refreshIosToken, which spells tokenHash outside any lookup.

src/lib/auth/tokens/mobile-token.ts#refr.reason: iOS refresh rotation; no digest lookup: it reads oldRow.tokenHash (the row the route already looked up) only as the key of its retry cache. The mint is gated inline by passkeyEnforcementBlocks after replay and family-expiry checks and before issueIosToken.

src/app/api/extension/token/refresh/rout.reason: Revocation-only replay detection: reads an already-revoked row and can only revoke its family; it grants nothing (the refresh itself goes through validateExtensionToken).

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#revokeToken.reason: RFC 7009 revocation: the lookup can only revoke the presented token or its family; it grants nothing.

src/lib/auth/tokens/service-account-toke.reason: Service account tokens are not user-bound; a passkey is a human-identity requirement.

src/lib/auth/tokens/scim-token.ts#valida.reason: SCIM tokens are tenant provisioning credentials, not user-bound.

src/app/api/vault/admin-reset/route.ts#h.reason: One-time admin vault reset action token, presented by a signed-in user; not a reusable bearer API credential.

src/app/api/emergency-access/accept/rout.reason: One-time emergency access invitation token, accepted under a session: the digest lookup and the CAS transition({ where: { id, tokenHash } }) on the row it found; not a reusable bearer API credential.

src/app/api/emergency-access/reject/rout.reason: One-time emergency access invitation token, rejected under a session: the digest lookup and the CAS transition({ where: { id, tokenHash } }) on the row it found; not a reusable bearer API credential.

src/app/api/teams/invitations/accept/rou.reason: One-time team invitation token, accepted under a session whose email must match the invitation's; not a reusable bearer API credential.

src/app/api/share-links/verify-access/ro.reason: Share link token: an anonymous recipient capability, not a user-bound credential.

src/app/s/[token]/download/route.ts#GET.reason: Share link token: an anonymous recipient capability, not a user-bound credential.

src/app/s/[token]/page.tsx#SharePage.reason: Share link token: an anonymous recipient capability, not a user-bound credential.

src/app/api/extension/token/exchange/rou.reason: One-time extension bridge code (read, then CAS-consumed); the code's mint is gated and the minted extension token is gated per use by validateExtensionToken (C5).

src/app/api/mobile/token/route.ts#handle.reason: One-time mobile bridge code (read, then CAS-consumed); the code's mint is gated and the minted IOS_APP token is gated per use by validateExtensionToken (C5).

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#resolveCodeT.reason: One-time MCP authorization code, read only to pick the tenant for the IP gate; the exchange is gated inline and the token is refresh-bound (SC1).

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#exchangeCode.reason: One-time MCP authorization code exchange, gated inline by passkeyEnforcementBlocks before the mint; the minted token is refresh-bound (SC1).

src/app/api/emergency-access/route.ts#ha.reason: Duplicate-grant check: where is duplicateGrantWhere(ownerId, granteeEmail, now) (emergency-access-server.ts), an owner/email/status predicate with no digest. Decides whether a new invitation may be created; authenticates nothing.

src/lib/emergency-access/emergency-acces.reason: where is the caller's args.where spread; the digest arrives through it from the accept/reject routes, whose own lookups are classified above. Revocation-style state change, grants no API access.
where is the caller's args.where spread (same as transition); a grant state change that grants no API access.

src/lib/auth/session/user-session-invali.reason: Revokes every token row of a batch of users and consumes their unused single-use codes (the database half of invalidateUserSessions, also run in the departure, SCIM delete, team removal and admin passkey revoke transactions); the spread is a tenantFilter keyed by userId/tenantId, not a digest. Revocation only.

src/lib/tenant/member-containment.ts#con.reason: A tenant admin's containment of a member (#1016): revokes the SCIM and service-account tokens the member minted (one bulk compare-and-set each) and reads their emergency-access grants to revoke; the spreads are the live predicates (tenantId / createdById / ownerId), never a digest. Revocation only.

src/app/api/user/mcp-tokens/[id]/route.t.reason: Revokes a session user's own MCP refresh family; the spread is a familyId/userId/tenantId scope, not a digest. Revocation only.

src/app/api/share-links/route.ts#handleG.reason: Session-authenticated listing of the user's own share links; where is a record built from creator and entry ids, never a digest.

src/app/api/share-links/mine/route.ts#ha.reason: Session-authenticated listing of the user's own share links; where is built from creator/type/status filters and the spread is a cursor, never a digest.

src/app/api/vault/delegation/check/route.reason: DelegationSession lookup whose McpAccessToken relation filter spreads tokenBinding ({ id } of the caller's own already-validated MCP token, or {}); filters by row id, never by digest.

src/app/api/passwords/[id]/route.ts#hand.reason: PasswordEntry update (both the history-snapshot and the plain branch): data is a Record<string, unknown> built by assigning scalar columns plus tags: tagSet(ids) (a Tag relation by id); it names no share-link relation and filters by no digest.

src/app/api/v1/passwords/[id]/route.ts#h.reason: PasswordEntry update over API v1: data is a Record<string, unknown> built by assigning scalar columns plus tags: tagSet(ids) (a Tag relation by id); it names no share-link relation and filters by no digest.

src/app/api/v1/passwords/route.ts#handle.reason: PasswordEntry create over API v1: the unreadable spreads are toBlobColumns/toOverviewColumns (src/lib/crypto/crypto-blob.ts), which return the three ciphertext/iv/authTag scalar columns each; no relation, no digest.

src/lib/services/personal-password-servi.reason: PasswordEntry create: the unreadable spreads are toBlobColumns/toOverviewColumns (src/lib/crypto/crypto-blob.ts), which return scalar ciphertext/iv/authTag columns; no relation, no digest.

src/lib/services/team-password-service.t.reason: TeamPasswordEntry create: the unreadable spreads are toBlobColumns/toOverviewColumns (src/lib/crypto/crypto-blob.ts), which return scalar ciphertext/iv/authTag columns; no relation, no digest.
TeamPasswordEntry update: data is a Record<string, unknown> built by assigning scalar columns plus tags: tagSet(ids) (a TeamTag relation by id); no share-link relation, no digest.

src/app/api/teams/[teamId]/route.ts#hand.reason: Team update: data is a Record<string, unknown> built by assigning scalar columns (name, description); no token relation, no digest.

src/app/api/tenant/mcp-clients/[id]/rout.reason: McpClient update: data is a Record<string, unknown> built by assigning scalar columns (name, redirectUris, allowedScopes, isActive); it names no token relation and filters by no digest.

src/app/api/tenant/policy/route.ts#handl.reason: Tenant policy update: data is a Record<string, unknown> built by assigning scalar columns (session, token-timeout, passkey, retention and network policy fields); no token relation, no digest.

src/lib/auth/session/auth-adapter.ts#upd.reason: Auth.js adapter updateUser: data is the rest of Partial<AdapterUser> (name, email, image, emailVerified) that Auth.js passes in, keyed by the user id; it is not a bearer lookup and carries no relation.

src/workers/retention-gc-worker/sweep.ts.reason: Retention sweep: the computed select key is the entry's tenantRetentionColumn, a closed union of Tenant retention-day scalar columns from the retention registry; it selects, it never filters by a digest.

src/lib/emergency-access/emergency-acces.reason: Scope guard of transition / bulkTransition: reads whether the caller's where names an owner, grantee, email or tokenHash so an unscoped state change under bypass RLS is refused; no lookup, grants no API access.

src/lib/audit/audit-logger.ts#METADATA_B.reason: Audit metadata blocklist: names tokenHash so the key is stripped from logged metadata; a list of keys to redact, not a lookup.

src/lib/logger/redact-keys.ts#SECRET_RED.reason: Logger redaction list: names tokenHash and codeHash so pino redacts them; a list of keys to hide, not a lookup.

prisma/migrations/20260227050000_tenant_.reason: Defines resolve_tenant_id_from_row (a row's tenant from its parent row, found by the user, owner, team, entry, share or grant id inside the row), enforce_tenant_id_from_context (fills or checks tenant_id against the app.tenant_id and bypass settings; for users it also creates a bootstrap tenant) and the owner-membership function, and attaches the trigger to every tenant table, token tables included. They read settings and parent ids, never a digest column, and look no token up.

prisma/migrations/20260228020000_force_r.reason: Redefines resolve_tenant_id_from_row to add scim_group_mappings (scim_tokens is a name in the team-scoped list). It returns the tenant of a row's parent: the user (user_id, created_by_id), owner, team, entry, share or grant found by the id inside the row; no digest column is read and nothing is looked up by a token.

prisma/migrations/20260321110000_convert.reason: Re-creates resolve_tenant_id_from_row, enforce_tenant_id_from_context and ensure_tenant_owner_membership_after_user_insert with uuid casts after the id columns change type; same behaviour as phase 8 (a row's tenant from the user, owner, team, entry, share or grant id inside it, the app.tenant_id and bypass settings), token tables only as names in lists; no digest column, no token lookup.

prisma/migrations/20261102000000_share_c.reason: Defines share_creator_admitted(share id): it sets a call-scoped bypass for password_shares, team_password_entries and team_members, reads the one password_shares row by its id plus the team entry and the creator's membership, restores the settings and returns a boolean (may the creator still serve the share). It selects by id, never by the share's digest.

prisma/migrations/20261115100000_team_in.reason: Renames team_invitations.token to token_hash and rewrites each stored value to its SHA-256 hex in place (ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE ... USING), then renames the unique index. A one-time schema change over every row; nothing is looked up by a token.

prisma/migrations/20261108000000_share_a.reason: Replaces share_creator_admitted with two more serve-time rules: the team policy (sharing allowed, share password required, read from team_policies and the share's access_password_hash being null) and the personal entry's trashed state (password_entries). Still reads password_shares by id and returns a boolean; no digest column is named.

prisma/migrations/20261114000100_share_c.reason: Replaces share_creator_admitted with one more serve-time rule: a team share is refused when its creator departed the tenant at or after creating it (tenant_members.deactivated_at and tenant_member_departures.departed_at, both LEFT JOINed; the call-scoped bypass grows by those two tables). Still reads password_shares by id and returns a boolean; no digest column is named.

prisma/migrations/20261115000300_share_c.reason: Replaces share_creator_admitted with one more serve-time rule: a team share is refused when its creator departed the tenant at or after their team membership began (team_members.admitted_at or created_at against tenant_members.deactivated_at and tenant_member_departures.departed_at). Still reads password_shares by id and returns a boolean; no digest column is named.
